Name: Tree Of The Winter Star Retexture by MolaMole (Alternative Textures Version)
Author: glymr
Description:
[size=4][b]This should work with 1.6! Please let us know if you encounter any problems.[/b][/size]

MolaMole kindly gave me permission to turn her lovely "Tree of the Winter Star Retexture" into an Alternative Textures version, and even added some additional retextures for the L. Light String and the Winter Tree Decal! This version includes all 36 of the Winter Star Tree retextures (18 without presents, 18 with presents), 36 different versions of the light string (2 for each color), and 9 different Winter Tree Decals.

You will need Alternative Textures to see the different versions. If you're not familiar with how to use Alternative Textures, please look up a user guide. You will need to go to Robin's and buy a Paint Can, then click on the item you want to retexture with the paint can equipped.

If you enjoy this mod, we hope you will endorse it. ^_^

---

You can find MolaMole's mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/130027263?tab=user+files]here[/url] and glymr's mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/69042553?tab=user+files]here[/url]. Please check them out!

MolaMole's carrd is [url=https://lunarmole.carrd.co/]here[/url]!
